goal: Show academic preparation, program fit, research interest, and career direction.

structure.instruction: State your academic interest and what field you want to study.
Summarize relevant study, grades, projects, and technical preparation.
Show relevant experience that supports the chosen program.
Explain modules, specialization, labs, faculty, or academic strengths.
Mention specific academic features only if they are real and relevant.
Describe short-term and long-term goals after completion.

banned_phrases: I have always wanted to study in Korea since childhood
I will do anything to get admitted
this is my way to stay in Korea
the visa is my main concern
preferred_language: My background in X has prepared me for...
This program aligns with my interest in...
The curriculum offers the specialization I need in...
I intend to develop expertise in...
After completing this program, I plan to...
quality_checklist: The program and university are named clearly
The document matches the study plan and supporting files
